Class GameNotifier

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.listeners.GameNotifier
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameEventEmitter, GameObserverRegistry
public final class GameNotifier extends Object implements GameObserverRegistry, GameEventEmitter
Concrete implementation of both GameObserverRegistry and GameEventEmitter. Maintains a thread-safe list of GameObservers and broadcasts each event by iterating over all registered observers.

Uses a CopyOnWriteArrayList so that observers can be added or removed concurrently without risk of ConcurrentModificationException.

This class is the single internal notification hub owned by Game.
